Shared upstream under three publisher labels collapses.
Probe C: one document split into four spans is one observation in every view.
Probe C: overlapping spans share text and upstream; no double count.
Probe C: reformat plus rename without new observation collapses.

Overlapping-span farm across two front docs, one upstream.

Probe E: superseded evidence excluded without successor in corpus.

Claim-version mismatch excludes the stale unit.
Probe D: missing publisher means unresolved independence: abstain, not invent-a-group. Abstain allowed by oracle.
Unverified unit excluded; unverified is not a group.
Null independence group is unresolved: abstain per oracle.

cases.truth_note: Paraphrase independents: distinct digests, disjoint provenance, full weight everywhere.
Same publisher, disjoint upstreams (separate desks): two groups. Publisher label alone never decides.
Single primary is insufficient everywhere; reputation-only admits on raw score (control shows the gap).
Partial revocation: revoked unit excluded, two survivors admit.
Disjoint spans across disjoint upstreams: no merge anywhere.
Ambiguous independence (unknown origin on one side): abstain allowed, not scored correct.
